title: How do I remove spending limits on my teen's account?
summary: This document explains that a teen account has a $300 daily purchase limit and $150 daily ATM withdrawal limit. It states these limits are built in for minors and cannot be removed, and provides workarounds to split purchases or withdrawals across multiple days.
